newsitem.title: KENYA: Rwanda says two priests among six killed on bus.
newsitem.headline: Rwanda says two priests among six killed on bus.

text.p: Rwanda state radio said on Tuesday six people including two priests and three girls were killed in a bus in the south of the country by unidentified attackers.
It said the attack on the bus was on Sunday night in Gikongoro province. It named the two Rwandan priests and said the dead also included a medical assistant and three girls.
The radio was monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation.
The Tutsi-dominated army in neighbouring Burundi said on Monday it intercepted and killed 18 Rwandan guerrillas trying to reach southern Rwanda from Zaire through northwestern Burundi.
Rwandan radio said last week that 25 people were killed in Gikongoro between April 28 and 30 by unidentified attackers.
Rwandan Hutu rebels massacred 17 schoolgirls and a Belgian nun and wounded 14 other schoolgirls in an attack on schools in northwestern Rwanda on April 29, state radio also reported.

Rwandan authorities say the attacks are mounted by former Hutu troops and Interahamwe militiamen who returned to Rwanda from Tanzania and Zaire with refugees late last year and who led the genocide of 800,000 Tutsis and Hutu moderates in 1994.
